claims_and_limits: Cadence announced Maestro on October 26; first models are for select early-access customers in Q4 2026.

Cadence reports initial improvements of up to 30% quality of results and up to fivefold token efficiency against a general-purpose foundation model; the release does not provide a reproducible protocol or broad cost accounting.
A bounded test, total-cost comparison and human acceptance gates are TechMind Hub assessment, not claims demonstrated by the release.

visual.central_question: Does an agent deliver an accepted engineering design under explicit constraints?
